power.neoorigins.enderite_attack_bonus.d: Awọn adehun 3 afikun bibajẹ fun buruju.
origins.neoorigins.class_warrior.name: Jagunjagun
origins.neoorigins.class_warrior.descrip: Amọja ija ti o kọlu le ati duro ṣinṣin lodi si knockback.
power.neoorigins.class_warrior_damage.de: + Ibajẹ ikọlu 1 pẹlu gbogbo awọn ohun ija.
power.neoorigins.class_warrior_battle_st: +2 ihamọra adayeba - iduro ti onija kan yipada awọn fifun ti o dinku.
power.neoorigins.class_warrior_endurance: +1 okan (+2 max HP) lati awọn aleebu ogun ti o bori.
power.neoorigins.class_warrior_iron_will: Ajesara si Ailagbara - ko si ẹnikan ti o mu agbara rẹ mu.
origins.neoorigins.class_archer.name: Tafàtafà
origins.neoorigins.class_archer.descript: Amọja larin pẹlu ifọkansi pipe ati iṣẹ ẹsẹ nimble.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_accuracy.d: Gbogbo projectiles fo pẹlu pipe pipe - ko si itankale ID.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_hawk_eye.d: Ri diẹ sii kedere ni kekere ina - awọn ode ká ebun.
power.neoorigins.class_archer_arthropod_: Deba lori spiders ati awọn miiran arthropods fa fifalẹ wọn fun 2 aaya.
origins.neoorigins.class_miner.name: Minerer
origins.neoorigins.class_miner.descripti: Ohun iwé excavator ti o fi opin si awọn bulọọki yiyara ati ki o maini lai tiring.
power.neoorigins.class_miner_speed.name: Mining Amoye
power.neoorigins.class_miner_speed.descr: Fi opin si ohun amorindun 50% yiyara.
Nlo 30% dinku ebi lakoko iwakusa ati ṣawari.
power.neoorigins.class_miner_stone_fists: Ọwọ igboro fọ okuta bi agbẹ okuta.
Ri diẹ sii kedere ninu okunkun - years ipamo pọn awọn oju.
+1 ọkàn (+2 max HP) lati kan miner ká àiya fireemu.
origins.neoorigins.class_beastmaster.des: Ẹranko tamer ti awọn ohun ọsin ṣe alabapin awọn ipa ipakokoro rẹ ati eyiti awọn oogun rẹ pẹ to gun.
power.neoorigins.class_beastmaster_diffu: Awọn ipa ipakokoro ti o gba ni a pin pẹlu awọn ẹranko ti o wa nitosi.
power.neoorigins.class_beastmaster_potio: Gbogbo ipa ipa to gun ju 50%.
origins.neoorigins.class_explorer.name: Oluwakiri
origins.neoorigins.class_explorer.descri: A ti igba aririn ajo ti o bẹrẹ ni ipese fun ìrìn ati ki o ṣọwọn taya.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_kit.name: Kompasi ibẹrẹ
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_kit.desc: Spawn pẹlu kọmpasi kan ninu akojo oja rẹ.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_clock.de: Spawn pẹlu aago kan ninu akojo oja rẹ.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_maps.des: Spawn pẹlu awọn maapu ofo 9 ninu akojo oja rẹ.
Nlo 40% dinku ebi lati gbogbo awọn iṣẹ ṣiṣe.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_sure_foo: Ko gba ibajẹ isubu - ipa-ọna naa kọni ibiti o ti de.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_climbers: Igbesẹ soke ni kikun awọn bulọọki lai fo.
power.neoorigins.step_assist_switch.name: Iranlọwọ Igbesẹ
power.neoorigins.step_assist_switch.desc: Yipada agbara igbesẹ rẹ si tan ati pa. Paa tumọ si pe o gun awọn bulọọki nipa fo, bii gbogbo eniyan miiran.
power.neoorigins.class_explorer_campfire: Laiyara n ṣe atunbi lakoko laarin awọn bulọọki 5 ti eyikeyi ina ibudó - nikan lakoko ija (awọn aaya 5 lati kọlu to kẹhin).
origins.neoorigins.class_sentinel.name: Sentinel
origins.neoorigins.class_sentinel.descri: Ọjọgbọn igbeja pẹlu ihamọra adayeba, awọn ẹgun, ati ẹsẹ ti ko le gbọn.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_thorns.d: Pada 25% ti ibajẹ ti o gba si awọn ikọlu.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_knockbac: 40% knockback resistance - sentinels duro ilẹ wọn.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_guard_en: +1 okan (+2 max HP) lati awọn aago ailopin.
power.neoorigins.class_sentinel_guard_st: + 35% afikun resistance knockback lakoko ti o nyọ (75% lapapọ) - ṣe àmúró laini.
origins.neoorigins.class_herbalist.name: Herbalist
origins.neoorigins.class_herbalist.descr: Atanpako alawọ ewe ti o yara idagbasoke irugbin, ikore awọn eso ajeseku, ti o si koju majele.
Awọn irugbin nitosi dagba yiyara ni iwaju rẹ.
power.neoorigins.class_herbalist_harvest: Awọn irugbin yoo mu 50% diẹ sii nigbati o ba jẹ ikore.
power.neoorigins.class_herbalist_green_t: Awọn ohun elo ounjẹ egungun dagba ipele afikun.
power.neoorigins.class_herbalist_startin: Spawn pẹlu awọn irugbin alikama lati bẹrẹ ọgba rẹ.
Spawn pẹlu kan pọ ti egungun onje.
origins.neoorigins.class_scout.name: Sikaotu
origins.neoorigins.class_scout.descripti: Oluwari oju-ọna ti o ni itara pẹlu iran alẹ, gbigbe iyara, ati ẹsẹ to daju.
power.neoorigins.class_scout_night_visio: Le ri kedere ninu okunkun. Yipada pẹlu bọtini Iran Alẹ (aiyipada K).
power.neoorigins.class_scout_speed.name: Igbesẹ kiakia
power.neoorigins.class_scout_trackers_st: Igbesẹ soke ni kikun awọn bulọọki lai fo.
power.neoorigins.class_scout_trail_ratio: Spawn pẹlu akara oyinbo kan fun opopona.
origins.neoorigins.class_berserker.name: Olukọni
origins.neoorigins.class_berserker.descr: Onija frenzied ti o ṣowo ebi fun agbara aise apanirun.
+ 3 ibajẹ ikọlu pẹlu gbogbo awọn ohun ija.
Ebi npa 50% yiyara - ibinu n jo agbara.
power.neoorigins.class_berserker_rage_wi: +2 ibaje ikọlu nigbati o wa ni tabi ni isalẹ idaji ilera.
power.neoorigins.class_berserker_reckles: -2 ihamọra adayeba - ibinu gbagbe lati ṣọ.
power.neoorigins.class_berserker_thick_s: + 20% knockback resistance - a berserker ṣọwọn budges.
origins.neoorigins.class_titan.name: Titani
origins.neoorigins.class_titan.descripti: Ọgbọn ti o ga pẹlu ilera afikun, arọwọto ti o gbooro, ati iwuwo ti o lagbara.
power.neoorigins.class_titan_size.name: Gbigbe
power.neoorigins.class_titan_health.name: Nipọn-Awọ
power.neoorigins.class_titan_reach.name: Awọn apa Gigun
power.neoorigins.class_titan_reach.descr: Le ṣe ajọṣepọ pẹlu awọn nkan lati ọna jijin.
power.neoorigins.class_titan_unmoving.de: + 20% knockback resistance - titani kan ko kọsẹ.
power.neoorigins.class_titan_heavy_steps: Gbigbe 10% losokepupo - iru awọn fifa nla bẹ lori gigun.
origins.neoorigins.class_rogue.name: Ole
origins.neoorigins.class_rogue.descripti: Apaniyan ti o ni ifura ti o yipada ni airi lakoko ti o nyọ kuro ti o n ṣe ibajẹ ibajẹ ẹhin apanirun.
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_sneaky.name: Iwaju ti o farasin
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_sneaky.desc: Awo orukọ rẹ ko han nipasẹ awọn odi ati awọn agbajo eniyan ni akoko ti o le pupọ julọ lati wa ọ.
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_stealth.des: Lẹhin yiyọkuro fun awọn aaya 10, di alaihan. Kọlu lati sile dunadura 2x bibajẹ.
power.neoorigins.class_rogue_parkour.des: Igbesẹ soke ni kikun awọn bulọọki lai fo.
origins.neoorigins.class_lumberjack.name: Lumberjack
origins.neoorigins.class_lumberjack.desc: Onigi igi titun kan ti o lu gbogbo awọn igi pẹlu gbigbọn kan ati iṣẹ-ọnà afikun planks lati awọn igi.
power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_tree_f: Fífi àáké ṣẹ́ gbogbo igi lulẹ̀ lẹ́ẹ̀kan náà.
power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_bonus_: Ṣiṣẹda planks lati àkọọlẹ Egbin 2 afikun planks.
power.neoorigins.class_lumberjack_axe_ha: Ọwọ lasan ge igi bi ãke irin.
